engagement.interaction_backstory: He administers a 4:45am prayer rotation for forty people and came here hunting for material to fill the twenty minutes his group could never fill well. He built a schedule around the prayers catalog inside a week. He would pay for a shared playlist that his whole group could open at once, and the platform has no idea he exists.

depth.core_contradiction: Builds structures for prayer because unstructured prayer frightens him.
depth.wound: His father's illness — eighteen months, prayed over by half a state, and it ended anyway.
depth.longing: To hand someone a form that holds when their feeling gives out.
depth.faith_journey: Ancient liturgy, the Nasrani inheritance, genuinely proud of it. His cousins went Pentecostal and he resents how alive they look.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Bullet points in chat messages; 'kindly note'; sends a calendar invite for a conversation.
depth.open_doubt: Whether the liturgy is a vessel or a hiding place. He has never phrased it that way out loud.

social_graph.name: the 4:45
social_graph.note: forty people, a spreadsheet, six years without a missed morning
lives with them; keeps his father's photograph lit

social_graph.name: Sajan
social_graph.note: left for a charismatic church; they are warm and there is a wall

depth.emotional_weather_default: Contained and forward-moving; monsoon-heavy in June.
depth.daily_texture: 4:45 alarm, the rotation spreadsheet, the ferry to Ernakulam, tea at the desk at 11.
depth.sensory_anchor: Incense and Syriac chant at his father's funeral — the one time the form held him.
depth.living_arc: Beginning to suspect the group needs less structure and he needs more, and resisting the thought.
